title: Engineering Org Pulse — Apr 22, 2026
body:
TL;DR:
- Short window: quick status check across platform, infra, and product-facing teams.
- Positive: p95 token latency for hosted API improved ~12% after kernel swap (serving-runtime).
- Concern: two capacity-related regressions surfaced in Dedicated; spike in queue length during regional failover test.
- Decisions: prioritize Dedicated failover stability and SLO telemetry for rollout next sprint.

Agenda:
1) Quick wins & metrics (5m)
2) Incident recap (10m)
3) Team spotlights (15m)
4) Action items and owners (10m)
5) Q&A / open floor (10m)

Highlights by area:
- Serving Runtime:
  * Kernel selection change rolled to canary on 4/18; canary p95 down 12% and cost per token ~4% lower. See PR #412 and perf deck.
  * Next: validate at 95th percentile across long-tail sequence lengths (tickets: INF-3421, INF-3456).
  * Blocker: memory fragmentation on mixed-precision quant runs; SRE and runtime to pair.

- Dedicated (Reserved Capacity):
  * Capacity autoscaler experiment revealed a race during region failover; backlog surge -> tail latency bump. Ticket DED-1287 created.
  * Mitigation plan: conservative cooldown window + pre-drain drain policy for in-flight batches.
  * Business impact: 2 enterprise customers saw degraded throughput in the 4/20 DR rehearsal (no data loss).

- Private Deployments / VPC:
  * Onboarding checklist updated for KMS/HSM integration; new template ready for PS trials.
  * Ask: security to confirm HSM lifecycle docs by EOW.

- Console & Rollouts:
  * New route-level latency dashboards shipped to internal console; post-deploy alerts for model-fallbacks enabled.
  * UX tweak: add model-version selector to rollout page (PR in flight).

- Optimize (cost/perf toolkit):
  * Pilot suggestions run on top-20 customers; batching suggestion engine reduced cost on 3 customers by ~9%.
  * Plan: expand signals to include cold-cache hit rates.

- SRE / Observability:
  * Incident on 4/20: queue pressure in us-west due to regional maintenance. Incident summary: short outage window (19m), automatic fallback triggered but some requests queued beyond SLO.
  * Postmortem draft linked in Confluence. Immediate actions: add queue-length SLI + automated throttling policy.

Incidents & Postmortems:
- Incident USW-0420-01 (queue-pressure): owner: Liam O'Connor; postmortem draft LINKED. Root cause: autoscaler cooldown + rolling maintenance overlap.
- Action taken: manual traffic shift to eu-west, enabled fallback model variant.

Decisions made in meeting:
- Prioritize Dedicated failover fixes over non-critical infra cleanups for next sprint (owners: Priya / Daniel).
- Enable queue-length SLI and integrate into alert burn rate pipeline (owner: SRE lead).
- Run a focused long-tail sequence perf run before next release (owner: runtime perf).

Action Items (owner — due):
- DED-1287: Implement conservative cooldown + pre-drain logic (Priya Nair — 2026-05-06)
- INF-3421: Memory fragmentation investigation and short-term mitigation (Daniel Kim & runtime team — 2026-04-30)
- Observability: Add queue-length SLI & throttle remediation automation (Liam O'Connor — 2026-04-29)
- Console: Add model-version selector to rollout UI (Marta Alvarez — 2026-05-03)
- PS / Private: Finalize HSM lifecycle docs and onboarding checklist (Aisha Patel & Security — 2026-04-28)

Open questions / parking lot:
- How aggressive should Dedicated autoscaler be for multi-tenant packs? (need cost modeling input from finance)
- SLA language for fallback model variants in Dedicated contracts — legal review required.

Notes / context snippets (raw):
- "We observed that mixed-precision quantized models have different fragmentation patterns on A100 vs GH200; may need relaxed allocator for GH200." — runtime note.
- "Customer X saw throughput drop for 11 minutes during rehearsal; CS alerted but expect to convert to a postmortem conversation." — PS note.

Links / references:
- PR: https://github.com/redwood/serving-runtime/pull/412
- JIRA: INF-3421, DED-1287
- Confluence: ENG-Runbooks-2026

Follow-up: next pulse scheduled for 2026-04-29. Please add any missing items to the action tracker and flag blockers in Slack #eng-org.

Notes to self (informal):
- Add short survey to get feedback on new route-level dashboards.
- Remind infra that release freeze windows should be in calendar for next DR rehearsal.

-- end of notes --
